standard.summary: 每张图使用两种 caption（如短描述 + 长描述）交替或混合训练。让模型同时学习精确触发和泛化描述。
standard.effect: 短 caption（如触发词）绑定概念身份，长 caption（自然语言描述）绑定视觉属性。dual_caption_short_key 和 dual_caption_long_key 指定 JSON sidecar 中的键名。
standard.whenToUse: 数据有 JSON sidecar 且同时包含短标签和长描述时。想让模型既能被精确触发又能响应自然语言时。
standard.avoidWhen: 只有纯 .txt caption 且没有结构化数据时。

standard_en.summary: Trains on two captions per image (a short description plus a long one), alternating or mixing them, so the model learns both a precise trigger and a general description.
standard_en.effect: The short caption (a trigger word) binds the concept's identity, while the long caption (a natural-language description) binds its visual attributes. dual_caption_short_key and dual_caption_long_key name the keys in the JSON sidecar.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the data has a JSON sidecar holding both short tags and a long description, and you want the model both precisely triggerable and responsive to natural language.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you only have plain .txt captions and no structured data.

advanced.principle: 每步从短/长 caption 中按比例选择一种作为当前 batch 的文本条件。可以理解为 caption 层面的 dropout——有时只给触发词（强化身份绑定），有时给完整描述（强化视觉属性学习）。
advanced.intervention: DataLoader 读取 JSON sidecar 时提取 short/long 字段，按比例选择。
advanced.expectedImpact: 在同时需要精确触发和自然语言控制的场景下改善 5-10%。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 caption_source_mix_enabled 互斥——两者都做多路 caption 采样。

advanced_en.principle: Each step picks one of short/long captions by ratio as the batch's text condition. Think of it as dropout at the caption level — sometimes only the trigger word (reinforcing identity binding), sometimes the full description (reinforcing visual-attribute learning).
advanced_en.intervention: The DataLoader extracts short/long fields when reading the JSON sidecar and selects by ratio.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: 5-10% improvement in scenarios needing both precise triggering and natural-language control.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Mutually exclusive with caption_source_mix_enabled — both do multi-way caption sampling.
